```{r}
#| label: rt-angle-data

# set up data for modeling

deg <- 40 # angle unit size
yrs <- 2  # age unit size

# filter to non-CAT, add age group, stimulus, angle
mrot_lme_data <- mrot_rt_trial |>
  filter(#!adaptive,            # exclude CAT runs
         correct == 1,         # exclude incorrect responses
         trial_number != 1) |> # exclude each run's first trial
  mutate(
    item_group = factor(item_group),
    stimulus   = factor(stimulus),
    site_label = factor(site_label),
    angle_sc   = (angle - mean(angle)) / deg, # scale to 1 unit = 40
    adaptive   = factor(adaptive), 
    age_sc     = (age - mean(age)) / yrs, # scale to 2 units = sd
    task       = "mrot"  # constant; slope_preds uses it for the overall effect
  ) |>
  select(site_label, user_id, run_id,  matches("age"), trial_number,
         item_group, stimulus, angle, angle_sc, rt_s, log_rt, adaptive, task)

# effects code all factors
contrasts(mrot_lme_data$site_label) <- contr.sum(levels(mrot_lme_data$site_label))
contrasts(mrot_lme_data$item_group) <- contr.sum(levels(mrot_lme_data$item_group))
contrasts(mrot_lme_data$stimulus) <- contr.sum(levels(mrot_lme_data$stimulus))
```

```{r}
#| label: dimensionality-level

# 2D vs 3D overall response time, restricted to the angles both were
# administered at. Reported instead of a slope contrast, because the two
# stimulus types do not span the same angles (see Methods).
shared_angles <- mrot_lme_data |>
  distinct(item_group, angle) |>
  count(angle) |>
  filter(n == n_distinct(mrot_lme_data$item_group)) |>
  pull(angle)

# NB: mrot_lme_data carries sum contrasts on item_group, under which the
# coefficient is a deviation from the grand mean (half the 2D-3D difference).
# Rebuild the factor here so the coefficient is the 3D-vs-2D contrast directly.
dim_data <- mrot_lme_data |>
  filter(angle %in% shared_angles) |>
  mutate(item_group = factor(as.character(item_group), levels = c("2d", "3d")))

dim_mod <- lmer(log_rt ~ item_group + factor(angle) + (1 | user_id),
                data = dim_data, REML = FALSE,
                control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

dim_ratio <- coef(summary(dim_mod)) |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "term") |>
  filter(str_starts(term, "item_group")) |>
  transmute(estimate = Estimate, std.error = `Std. Error`, statistic = `t value`,
            ratio = exp(abs(Estimate))) |>
  as.list()
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-angle-model
#| cache: true

# Cached because the four-way model takes several minutes to fit and nothing
# downstream of it changes between most renders. Caching keys on this chunk's
# code only, so it will NOT notice changes to mrot_lme_data in _00_data_prep;
# delete mrot_paper_cache/ (or set cache: false) after changing the data.
full_mod <- lmer(log_rt ~ angle_sc * stimulus * site_label * age_sc +
                   trial_number * stimulus + 
                   adaptive * stimulus +   # not * site_label: rural is wholly adaptive (see Methods)
                   (1 + angle_sc | user_id),
                 data = mrot_lme_data,
                 REML = FALSE,
                 control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
full_mod_stats <- model_performance(full_mod, estimator = "ML")
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-angle-fits

# extract stimuli predictors for later joining
stim_map <- mrot_lme_data |> distinct(angle, angle_sc, item_group, stimulus)

# create angle level as correctly spaced factor
angle_levels <- mrot_lme_data |>
  distinct(angle) |>
  arrange(angle) |>
  mutate(angle_level = factor(angle, levels = as.character(seq(20, 160, 20)),
                              ordered = TRUE))

# create data-spanning grid points for prediction
age_seq <- seq(min(mrot_lme_data$age_sc), max(mrot_lme_data$age_sc), length.out = 100)
pred_grid <- datagrid(angle_sc = unique,        # each angle
                      stimulus = unique,        # each stimulus
                      site_label = unique,      # each site
                      age_sc = age_seq,         # 100 equally spaced values of age
                      trial_number = mean,
                      adaptive = unique, 
                      newdata = mrot_lme_data) |>
  select(rowid, angle_sc, stimulus, site_label, age_sc, adaptive, trial_number) |>
  mutate(age = age_sc * sd(mrot_lme_data$age) + mean(mrot_lme_data$age),
         age = map_dbl(age, \(a) max(a, min(mrot_lme_data$age))),
         age_group = cut(age, breaks = age_breaks, labels = age_band_labels,
                         include.lowest = FALSE, right = FALSE),
         task = "mrot") |>
  inner_join(stim_map) |> # only items that actually exist (i.e. no shape 160, only rabbit 20)
  left_join(mrot_lme_data |> distinct(angle, angle_sc)) |>
  left_join(angle_levels)

# fitted values for the figure, averaged over the observed trials (as for the
# slopes). trial_number and adaptive are not grouped over: the figure does not
# distinguish them, so predictions are averaged across them.
grid_preds <- c("angle", "item_group", "stimulus", "site_label", "age_group")

avg_preds <- avg_predictions(full_mod,
                             newdata = mrot_lme_data,
                             re.form = NA,
                             by = grid_preds) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  left_join(angle_levels)
```

```{r}
#| label: common-range-contrast

# 3D items were not administered at 160 degrees, and the angle function is not
# linear, so slopes fitted over each stimulus type's own range are not
# comparable -- including 2D's 120-160 segment raises its slope. Refit on the
# angles both types share so the contrast compares like with like.
shared_data <- mrot_lme_data |>
  filter(angle %in% shared_angles) |>
  mutate(angle_sc = (angle - mean(angle)) / deg)
contrasts(shared_data$site_label) <- contr.sum(levels(shared_data$site_label))
contrasts(shared_data$stimulus)   <- contr.sum(levels(shared_data$stimulus))

common_mod <- lmer(log_rt ~ angle_sc * stimulus * site_label * age_sc +
                     trial_number * stimulus +
                     adaptive * stimulus +
                     (1 + angle_sc | user_id),
                   data = shared_data, REML = FALSE,
                   control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

common_slopes <- slopes(common_mod, newdata = shared_data, re.form = NA,
                        variables = "angle_sc", by = "item_group") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(item_group, estimate, std.error) |>
  nest(s = -item_group) |>
  deframe()   # common_slopes[["2d"]]$estimate

common_contrast <- hypotheses(
    slopes(common_mod, newdata = shared_data, re.form = NA,
           variables = "angle_sc", by = "item_group"),
    hypothesis = "b2 - b1 = 0") |>   # b1 = 2d, b2 = 3d
  as_tibble() |> as.list()

# the same contrast over each type's full range, for comparison
full_contrast <- hypotheses(
    slopes(full_mod, newdata = mrot_lme_data, re.form = NA,
           variables = "angle_sc", by = "item_group"),
    hypothesis = "b2 - b1 = 0") |>
  as_tibble() |> as.list()
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-angle-slopes

# extract angle slopes for each predictor
# "adaptive" is deliberately absent. full_mod has no adaptive-by-angle term, so
# it cannot represent a format difference in angular sensitivity; averaging over
# the observed trials would report only the differing site composition of the two
# formats (adaptive trials are 45% from wholly-adaptive uniandes-co-rural, the
# flattest site, against 0% of fixed-form trials). The format check is reported in
# the Methods instead, restricted to the sites that used both formats.
slope_preds <- c("task", "item_group", "stimulus", "site_label", "age_group") # trial-number

# Slopes are average marginal effects over the observed data rather than over
# pred_grid: balancing upweights cells where a stimulus type is thinly
# represented, and 3D items are unevenly distributed across age (see Methods).
# pred_grid is retained for the fitted curves in the figure.
get_pred_slopes <- \(pred) {
  slopes(full_mod,
         newdata = mrot_lme_data,
         re.form = NA,
         variables = "angle_sc",
         by = pred) |> as_tibble() |>
    rename(value = !!pred) |>
    mutate(predictor = pred, .before = value)
}

pred_slopes <- map(slope_preds, get_pred_slopes) |> list_rbind()

# The same item-type slopes averaged over the balanced grid instead of the
# observed trials. Quoted in the Results and Limitations so the figures there
# cannot drift from Table S4, which recomputes them from an identical model.
grid_item_slopes <- slopes(full_mod, newdata = pred_grid, re.form = NA,
                           variables = "angle_sc", by = "item_group") |>
  as_tibble() |> select(item_group, estimate) |> deframe()

obs_item_slopes <- pred_slopes |>
  filter(predictor == "item_group") |>
  select(value, estimate) |> deframe()

pred_slopes_tbl <- pred_slopes |>
  select(predictor, value, estimate, std.error, p.value) |>
  mutate(estimate_rt = exp(estimate)) |>
  mutate(interpretation = mult_to_pct(estimate_rt, "slower", "faster"),
         interpretation = paste(interpretation, glue("per {deg}°")),
         p.value = map_chr(p.value, fmt_p)) |>
  mutate(across(c(estimate, estimate_rt), \(x) round(x, 2)))
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-angle-slope-tests

get_pred_slope_test <- \(pred) {
  slopes(full_mod,
         newdata = mrot_lme_data,
         re.form = NA,
         variables = "angle_sc",
         by = pred,
         hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise) |>
    mutate(predictor = pred, .before = everything())
}
pred_slope_tests <- map(slope_preds[-1], get_pred_slope_test) |> list_rbind()

pred_slope_tests_tbl <- pred_slope_tests |> as_tibble() |>
  select(predictor, hypothesis, estimate, std.error, p.value) |>
  mutate(estimate_rt = exp(estimate)) |>
  mutate(interpretation = mult_to_pct(estimate_rt, "steeper", "flatter"),
         p.value = map_chr(p.value, fmt_p))
```

```{r}
#| label: angle-accuracy

# Accuracy against angle, the other half of the Shepard and Metzler signature.
# Fitted on all administered trials rather than correct ones only, so this is
# built from mrot_rt_trial rather than from mrot_lme_data.
mrot_acc_data <- mrot_rt_trial |>
  filter(trial_number != 1, !is.na(angle)) |>
  mutate(item_group = factor(item_group),
         site_label = factor(site_label),
         angle_sc   = (angle - mean(angle)) / deg,
         age_sc     = (age - mean(age)) / yrs,
         task       = "mrot")
contrasts(mrot_acc_data$item_group) <- contr.sum(levels(mrot_acc_data$item_group))
contrasts(mrot_acc_data$site_label) <- contr.sum(levels(mrot_acc_data$site_label))

# A deliberately simpler specification than full_mod: the purpose here is to
# establish that accuracy falls as response time rises, not to partition the
# accuracy effect across the same four-way structure.
acc_mod <- glmer(correct ~ angle_sc * item_group + site_label + age_sc + (1 | user_id),
                 data = mrot_acc_data, family = binomial,
                 control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                        optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

# Reported on the probability scale, in percentage points per 40 degrees, since
# the log-odds slopes differ between stimulus types only because 3D items sit
# lower on the logistic curve.
acc_slope <- \(pred) avg_slopes(acc_mod, newdata = mrot_acc_data, re.form = NA,
                               variables = "angle_sc", by = pred) |>
  as_tibble() |> rename(value = !!pred) |>
  mutate(pp = 100 * estimate, pp_se = 100 * std.error,
         p.value = map_chr(p.value, fmt_p))

acc_overall <- acc_slope("task")
acc_by_type <- acc_slope("item_group")
acc_type <- \(g) acc_by_type |> filter(value == g)

# descriptive accuracy at the extremes of each type's administered range
acc_cells <- mrot_acc_data |>
  summarise(acc = mean(correct), n = n(), .by = c(item_group, angle)) |>
  arrange(item_group, angle)
acc_at <- \(g, a) acc_cells |> filter(item_group == g, angle == a) |> pull(acc)
acc_stats <- list(n_trials = format(nrow(mrot_acc_data), big.mark = ","),
                  n_runs = format(n_distinct(mrot_acc_data$run_id), big.mark = ","))
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-plot-prep

z_rt_cutoff <- 2
# data points to plot - cut off RT tails
mrot_lme_data_plot <- mrot_lme_data |>
  mutate(z_rt = scale(log_rt)[,1]) |>
  filter(abs(z_rt) <= z_rt_cutoff) |>
  left_join(angle_levels)

# empirical means and CIs
rt_summary <- mrot_lme_data |>
  group_by(across(all_of(grid_preds))) |>
  summarise(
    mean_rt = mean(log_rt),
    se_rt = sd(log_rt) / sqrt(n()),
    ci_lower = mean_rt - 1.96 * se_rt,
    ci_upper = mean_rt + 1.96 * se_rt,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(angle_levels)
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-angle-results

# set up various lists and functions for reporting model results in text

angle_stats <- mrot_lme_data |>
  summarise(age_mean = mean(age),
            age_sd = sd(age),
            age_min = min(age),
            age_max = max(age),
            n_trials = n(),
            n_runs = n_distinct(run_id)) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.integer), \(x) format(x, big.mark = ","))) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 2) |> format(nsmall = 1)))

mod_stats_tbl <- full_mod_stats |> as_tibble() |>
  select(R2_conditional, R2_marginal, RMSE) |>
  mutate(RMSE_exp = exp(RMSE)) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) round(x, 2)))

slope_str <- \(s) glue("$\\beta$ = {fmt_est(s$estimate)}, SE = {fmt_se(s$std.error)}, p {s$p.value}")
slope <- \(v) pred_slopes_tbl |> filter(value == v)
interp_str <- \(s) glue("$\\beta$ = {fmt_est(s$estimate)}, {s$interpretation}")

slope_diff_str <- \(s) glue("Δ = {fmt_est(s$estimate)}, SE = {fmt_se(s$std.error)}, p {s$p.value}")
slope_diff <- \(h) pred_slope_tests_tbl |> filter(hypothesis == h)
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-slopes-tbl

# The (3D) - (2D) row from pred_slope_tests compares each type over its own
# angle range, which is not a like-for-like comparison (see Results). The
# shared-range contrast is added alongside it rather than replacing it, so the
# table shows both and the discrepancy is visible rather than resolved silently.
common_contrast_row <- tibble(
  predictor = "item_group",
  value = "(3D) - (2D), 40-120° only",
  estimate = common_contrast$estimate,
  std.error = common_contrast$std.error,
  p.value = fmt_p(common_contrast$p.value),
  estimate_rt = exp(common_contrast$estimate),
  interpretation = mult_to_pct(exp(common_contrast$estimate), "steeper", "flatter")
)

slopes_tbl <- bind_rows(
  pred_slopes_tbl,
  pred_slope_tests_tbl |> rename(value = hypothesis),
  common_contrast_row
) |>
  filter(predictor != "task") |>
  select(-estimate_rt) |>
  # label the two item-type contrasts by the range each covers, so neither can
  # be mistaken for the other
  mutate(value = if_else(predictor == "item_group" & value == "(3d) - (2d)",
                         "(3d) - (2d), full range", value)) |>
  mutate(predictor = predictor |> fct_inorder()) |>
  arrange(predictor) |>
  mutate(predictor = predictor |>
           fct_recode("stimulus_type" = "item_group",
                      "site" = "site_label") |>
           str_replace("_", " ") |> str_to_sentence(),
         value = value |> str_replace_all("(?<=[0-9])d", "D")) |>
  mutate(p_num = str_extract(p.value, "(?<= ).*$") |> as.numeric(),
         interpretation = interpretation |> as.character(),
         interpretation = if_else(p_num < 0.05, interpretation, paste(interpretation, "(ns)"))) |>
  select(-p_num) |>
  mutate(across(matches("estimate"), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  mutate(std.error = std.error |> round(3))
```
